## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
* **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. All styling lives in a dedicated `style.css`.
* **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All design properties, layout rules, and states must be targeted via class or ID selectors.
* **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML must remain clean, semantic, and agnostic of visual styling — changing the site's look requires editing only the CSS file, never the markup.

**1.2 CSS Variables (`var(--...)`) & Theme Tokens**
Store every visual token in `:root`. Spec colors are mandatory; derived values are fixed extensions consistent with the palette:

```css
:root {
  /* Brand */
  --primary: #cd7f32;        /* bronze accent (spec) */
  --secondary: #b5a642;      /* brass (spec) */
  --copper: #b87333;         /* copper piping (spec) */
  --nebula: #5d3a9b;         /* nebula purple (spec) */

  /* Surfaces */
  --bg-primary: #0d1b33;     /* cosmic void (spec) */
  --bg-secondary: #142445;   /* raised deck panel (derived) */
  --bg-parchment: #e9dcb5;   /* weathered parchment (derived) */

  /* Text — contrast pairing is mandatory */
  --text-primary: #ffffff;   /* Star White — on dark surfaces only */
  --text-secondary: #b5a642; /* brass — on dark surfaces only */
  --text-ink: #2b1d0e;       /* spec text color — on parchment/brass surfaces ONLY */
  --text-success: #8fae8b;   /* verdigris patina (derived) */
  --text-error: #e07856;     /* ember red (derived) */

  /* Borders */
  --border-default: #cd7f32;
  --border-success: #8fae8b;
  --border-error: #e07856;

  /* Shape & depth — steampunk favors sharp, riveted frames */
  --radius-sm: 2px; --radius-md: 4px; --radius-lg: 8px;
  --shadow-sm: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  --shadow-md: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  --glow-nebula: 0 0 15px #5d3a9b;  /* signature glow (spec) */

  /* Motion & space */
  --spacing-gap: 1.5rem;
  --transition-fast: 150ms; --transition-normal: 300ms;
  --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);

  /* Layering */
  --z-dropdown: 100; --z-modal: 200; --z-toast: 300;
}
```

* **Contrast Pairing (mandatory):** dark surfaces (`--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`) pair exclusively with light text (`--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`); light surfaces (`--bg-parchment`, brass/copper finishes) pair exclusively with `--text-ink`. Never place `#2b1d0e` text on `#0d1b33` — the spec's "Text #2b1d0e" is the ink color for parchment and brass surfaces.
* **Border Radius & Shadows:** always via `--radius-*` / `--shadow-*` tokens; the signature `--glow-nebula` is reserved for featured elements.
* **Elevation/Stacking:** layered components (dropdown, modal, toast) consume `--z-*` tokens to prevent overlap conflicts.
* No raw hex values outside `:root` — every rule consumes `var(--...)`.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
* Dark mode must always be defined — for this build it is the **sole theme**: all tokens above are dark values defined directly in `:root`, and the page renders dark for every visitor without any HTML restructuring.
* **Exception (per source specification "Light: ✗ No / Dark: ✓ Full"):** this is a dark-only experience — no light-mode variant, no `.light` theme class, no theme toggle control, no `localStorage` theme persistence, and the light-mode background rules are not applicable. Do not build any of them.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
* Build all layout structures with **Flexbox** (`display: flex` / Tailwind flex utilities).
* **Default Alignment Rule:** every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` (`items-center`) unless an explicitly documented exception applies (equal-height card/tier rows may use `stretch`).
* **Mobile-Friendly First:** rows convert to columns on smaller viewports; no horizontal scrolling at any width from 320px up; fluid typography via `clamp()`.

**1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration**
* Use Tailwind CSS (CDN build acceptable) for layout, spacing, and responsive utilities, with all thematic styling in custom classes in `style.css` driven by CSS variables — or clean custom CSS using `@layer`/`@apply`. Pick one approach and apply it consistently.
* All utility usage must map back to CSS variables or generic reusable classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, `.tier`, `.faq-item`); no scattered arbitrary-value color utilities.

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
* **Text:** load via Google Fonts `<link>`: **'Rye'** as `--font-display` (the spec's identity font — brand wordmark, headlines, buttons, tier names) paired with a readable Google serif as `--font-base` for long-form body copy (e.g., 'Crimson Text' or 'Alegreya'), with `'Rye', cursive` retained as the spec's fallback stack. System fonts and local font files are forbidden.
* **Icons:** Google Material Symbols only (e.g., `settings` for gears, `rocket_launch`, `telescope`, `explore`, `public`, `star`, `check`, `close`, `help`, `mail`), loaded via the Google Fonts icon link. **Raw inline SVGs and local icon files are explicitly forbidden.**
* Decorative glyphs (gears, stars) must carry `aria-hidden="true"`.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

Style all states via CSS classes. Every state below must be implemented.

**2.1 Button Component Requirements**
* **Default:** `.btn` — `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px. Skin: brushed brass/bronze plate (layered linear-gradients over `--primary`/`--secondary`), 2px solid `var(--border-default)` frame, corner rivet dots via pseudo-element radial-gradients, `--text-ink` label. Variants: `.btn--primary` (brass plate), `.btn--secondary` (bronze outline, brass label on void), `.btn--danger` (ember red, visually distinct on dark).
* **Hover:** brightness shift plus intensified `--glow-nebula`; `cursor: pointer`.
* **Focus:** distinct keyboard focus ring (e.g., `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--nebula)`) — never remove outlines without replacement.
* **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)` plus inset shadow for a pressed-plate feel.
* **Loading:** `.is-loading` — disables pointer events to prevent double-clicks, sets `aria-busy="true"`, and renders a spinning gear (rotating Material `settings` icon or CSS spinner) without distorting button dimensions.
* **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale filter, `cursor: not-allowed`.
* **Success/Error:** temporary feedback styling driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error` (e.g., CTA confirms with verdigris border and check icon).

**2.2 Card Component Requirements**
* **Default:** flexible Flexbox column; two skins: `.card--parchment` (weathered parchment surface, `--text-ink` copy, torn-edge treatment per §5) and `.card--void` (`--bg-secondary` panel, 2px bronze border, brass/white copy, `--glow-nebula` shadow). Borders and elevation strictly via tokens.
* **Hover (interactive cards only):** elevation/shadow shift and `transform: translateY(-2px)`.
* **Focus-within:** bronze border highlight when a child link/button receives focus.
* **Loading (Skeleton):** `.skeleton` shimmer sweep (nebula-fog gradient animation) defined purely in CSS; skeleton blocks must match final layout dimensions to prevent jumps.
* **Empty State:** structured fallback layout featuring a Google Material icon and clear guidance text.

**2.3 Form & Input Requirements**
* **Structure:** `.input-group` — flex container wrapping a `<label>`, an input field, and a dedicated error-feedback container (`aria-live="polite"`).
* **States:** Empty, Focused (nebula ring), Filled, Valid (verdigris border + check icon), Invalid (ember border, `--text-error` message + error icon, `aria-invalid="true"`), Disabled, Read-only.
* **Skin:** brass-framed field — `--bg-secondary` well, 2px bronze border, brass text/caret — or parchment field with ink text. Both must satisfy contrast pairing.

**2.4 Modal / Popup Requirements**
* **States:** Opening (fade + scale), Open, Loading, Success/Error, Closing — all animated via CSS transitions (`var(--transition-normal)`).
* **UX Features:** centered flex overlay (`align-items: center; justify-content: center`), cosmic-void backdrop with nebula tint and blur, Material icon close button (`aria-label="Close"`), keyboard focus trapping with focus returned to the trigger on close, close via `Esc` and overlay click. Use `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby`, and `--z-modal`.

**2.5 FAQ Accordion Requirements**
* Each item is a `.faq-item` card; the question is a `<button>` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; the answer is a region animated open/closed via CSS (grid-template-rows or max-height technique). A chevron or gear indicator rotates when open. Fully keyboard operable. (Native `<details>`/`<summary>` is acceptable only if styled and animated without breaking semantics.)

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

* **Responsive by Default:** fluid `clamp()` type scale and responsive breakpoints without horizontal overflow from 320px up.
* **Smooth Animations:** CSS transitions on all state changes (`transition: var(--transition-normal)`); every animation (gear rotation, star twinkle, shimmer, modal, accordion, smooth scroll) must be disabled or reduced under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
* **Accessibility (a11y):** verified contrast pairs — `#ffffff` and `#b5a642` on `#0d1b33`/`#142445`; `#2b1d0e` on `#e9dcb5` and brass finishes. Never rely on color alone to communicate state (pair color with icons/text). Semantic HTML5 landmarks (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `footer`), a single `h1` with logical heading hierarchy, correct ARIA roles/labels on custom widgets, logical DOM/focus order, full keyboard operability, a skip-to-content link, and `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback (form errors, loading, success).
* **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change.
* **Destructive Actions:** `.btn--danger` must be visually distinct against the dark theme with sufficient contrast.
* **Anchor Navigation:** smooth in-page scrolling for header/footer links (respecting reduced motion) with `scroll-margin-top` on target sections.

## 4. DELIVERABLE & OUTPUT FORMAT

* **File Structure:** separate `index.html`, `style.css`, and `script.js`. A single deferred entry point (`<script src="script.js" defer></script>`); no inline `<script>` blocks, no inline styles, no inline SVGs.
* **Naming Convention:** BEM throughout for custom classes (`.btn--primary`, `.card--parchment`, `.faq-item__answer`, `.tier--featured`, `.footer__link`). If Tailwind is used, restrict it to layout/spacing/responsive utilities — never mix naming conventions.
* **JavaScript Scope:** `script.js` contains only behavior wiring — modal open/close with focus trap, accordion toggling, form validation with loading/success/error states, `aria-live` updates. No inline event handlers (`addEventListener` only).
* **No Unrequested Placeholders:** write real, on-theme English copy for every section (vintage sci-fi explorer voice). Lorem ipsum is forbidden. Placeholder `href="#"` is permitted only for footer/social destinations left unspecified.
* **Copy Locale:** all user-facing copy in English.

## 5. THEME VISUAL IMPLEMENTATION — STEAMPUNK NEBULA (CSS-ONLY)

All effects must be achieved with pure CSS (gradients, pseudo-elements, keyframes, Material Symbols glyphs). No images, no inline SVG.

* **Cosmic Void & Nebula:** body background layers — base `--bg-primary` plus multiple large radial-gradients in `--nebula` (low opacity) and a faint copper tint; star field from repeated tiny white radial-gradient dots at varied positions/sizes with a subtle opacity twinkle keyframe. Decorative layers are `aria-hidden` and `pointer-events: none`.
* **Interlocking Brass Gears:** Material Symbols `settings` glyphs at varied sizes and colors (`--secondary`, `--copper`, `--primary`), overlapped and offset to suggest meshing; each rotates slowly with staggered durations and alternating directions via CSS keyframes. Used as hero ornaments, section dividers, and icon badges (a large gear behind a smaller content icon). Rotation pauses under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
* **Copper Piping:** connectors built from elements with copper linear-gradient fills, pill-shaped segments, flange joints, and rivet dots via pseudo-elements/repeating radial-gradients — used to join the How It Works steps (horizontal on desktop, vertical on mobile).
* **Torn Parchment Containers:** `.card--parchment` surfaces — `--bg-parchment` base, irregular torn edges via `clip-path` polygon (or layered irregular border-radius), weathered grain via subtle repeating-linear-gradients, faint stain/vignette radial-gradients, optional stitched dashed bronze outline. All text on parchment uses `--text-ink`.
* **Brushed Bronze Metal:** layered linear-gradients (`--primary` → `--secondary` → `--primary`) crossed with fine repeating-linear-gradient lines for brushed texture — applied to buttons, the header bar, badges, and tier frames.
* **Signature Glow:** `--glow-nebula` (`0 0 15px #5d3a9b`) on featured elements only — hero CTA, featured pricing tier, modal.
* **Rivets & Frames:** 2px solid `var(--border-default)` frames with corner rivet dots on panels, cards, and the header.

## 6. PAGE SECTION REQUIREMENTS

* **6.0 Site Header (standard landing-page chrome):** slim sticky header in brushed bronze; brand wordmark in Rye with a gear icon; anchor links (Features, How It Works, Testimonials, Pricing, FAQ); compact `.btn--primary` CTA. On mobile, links wrap or collapse gracefully — never horizontal scroll.
* **6.1 Hero:** near-full-viewport section on the cosmic void with nebula gradients, twinkling stars, and slowly interlocking gears framing the composition (`overflow: hidden` so ornaments never cause horizontal scroll). `h1` headline in Rye, supporting copy in `--font-base`, primary CTA ("Board the Expedition" — opens the signup modal per §2.4) and secondary CTA ("Study the Star Charts" — anchors to Features). Include a themed icon motif (e.g., `telescope` or `rocket_launch` in a gear badge).
* **6.2 Features — 3 Cards:** responsive row of three `.card` components (parchment and/or void skins), each with a Material icon set in a brass gear badge, an Rye title, and real descriptive copy (e.g., charting the nebula, brass-driven propulsion, expedition logistics). Hover lift + glow on interactive cards.
* **6.3 How It Works — 3 Steps:** three numbered steps joined by copper piping; step numbers rendered as brass gauge/gear badges (1–3); each step has an icon, title, and copy. Row on desktop; column with vertical piping on mobile.
* **6.4 Testimonials:** three "explorer's log" parchment cards, each with a brass star rating (Material `star` icons with an `aria-label` such as "Rated 5 out of 5"), a quote in `--text-ink`, and an attributed invented name/rank (e.g., "Captain E. Blackwood, Airship Aurora").
* **6.5 Pricing — 3 Tiers:** three `.card` tiers — "Stoker" (entry), "Navigator" (featured), "Captain" (premium). Each includes a tier name in Rye, a real price with billing period, a feature list with Material check icons, and a CTA button. The featured tier is visually elevated (larger padding, `--glow-nebula`, "Most Popular" brass badge) and uses `.btn--primary`; the others use `.btn--secondary`.
* **6.6 FAQ:** 4–6 on-theme questions in the accessible accordion (§2.5), each with genuine English answers.
* **6.7 Final CTA:** centered band with intensified nebula glow and gear ornament; Rye headline; a `.btn--primary` that opens the signup modal containing an `.input-group` email form demonstrating all form states (§2.3) and modal states (§2.4): loading → success ("Your berth is reserved") with `aria-live` feedback; invalid input shows the inline error state.
* **6.8 Footer with Secondary Links:** brand block with one-line tagline; grouped secondary link columns (e.g., Expedition: Features / Pricing / FAQ; Company: About / Careers / Contact; Support: Help / Terms / Privacy); social icon links (Material icons with `aria-label`s); copyright line. All footer text maintains contrast pairing on the void background.
